name: Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs
description: Rävfallsstugan to Ammarnäs. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Rävfallet: Waterfall/rapid at the start bridge and hut cluster.
notes: STF gives 23 km and WFS LED.2784003 measures 23.334 km to the Ammarnäs ledstart/parking area. Naturkartan gives 21.0 km, its GPX measures about 21.252 km, OSM extraction about 21.558 km and Gaia about 21.1 km, all apparently ending near Näsberget/ski-slope access and omitting the unmarked village/ledstart stretch.

Official section is Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs, but the shorter route line ends near Näsberget while the WFS 23 km line reaches the ledstart/parking area across/near the next-section boundary. Naturkartan also says the village trail is unmarked.
The WFS route endpoint is about 88-94 m from the Rävfallsstugan hut/facility point and likely represents trail/bridge approach rather than cabin centroid.
Official Naturkartan/section-20 evidence supports a locked cabin/safety-space model, while local/field sources mention 18 beds, sauna, key via Ammarnäs Livs and other service details.
A 2021 field report found good bivouac options across bridge/forest, while a 2025 route-app note says good tent spots near the cabin are rare.

The Marsivagge bird-protection area has a real 15 May-1 Aug entry ban, but this does not automatically close the entire Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs stage. Route intersection with the closed polygon was not proven in this pass.

The 2026-03-30 Länsstyrelsen notice advises choosing another way around Ammarnäs-Björkfjället-Skeble, but it appears under snowmobile restriction/local exemption context rather than as a hiking closure.
